page.overview:
Who is Louveria Atkascha?

Queen Louveria Atkascha (née Larg), also known as Ruvelia or Revlia, is a minor unseen character and an indirect antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics. The consort ruler of Ivalice, she is the wife of the late King Ondoria III, mother to Prince Orinus, and sister to Duke Larg for whom Louveria becomes his strongest benefactor and supporter.

Following her husband's death, Louveria seizes power, receiving great pushback. She is opposed by Duke Goltanna and the council during the War of the Lions, who aim to crown Princess Ovelia, the adopted daughter of King Ondoria III, instead.

Born from House Larg, Louveria was the trueborn young sister to Duke Larg. She became queen at 20 years of age, and gave birth to three sons, while adopting Princess Ovelia. Their first two sons died shortly after their birth, assassinated at the behest of the council who hoped Princess Ovelia would succeed Louveria as queen. The council believed a sickly King Ondoria III would be unable to father another son, but Queen Louveria, nonetheless, gave birth to Prince Orinus, and Princess Ovelia was left in the care of Duke Larg.

Because King Ondoria III was unfit for the throne, Louveria and her retainers were in charge of most affairs of state even before the king collapsed at the birthday celebration of Prince Orinus from ill health. Ondoria passed without naming an heir, meaning both Princess Ovelia and Prince Orinus had a claim. Nonetheless, Queen Louveria accelerated a campaign to seize total control of the government, as she stripped those who opposed her—including members of the council and other royal family members—of their rank. The mother of King Ondoria III openly criticized her actions, and was banished to the Bunahan, with rumors of her having been poisoned.
